gen-gf-dekko-switzer: Switzer draws wire-like, tubular letters whose c tips stay well apart. Dekko, handwritten and loose with a squat brush-pen belly, is happiest on a brief line or two of display text, where its friendliness has room.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-fs-paquito: Confident without fuss, Paquito is a serif whose lowercase nearly reaches capital height, and Dela Gothic One gives it a display-sized shout. The heading hits hard; the body is built for brief stints of reading.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-familjen-grotes: Delius Unicase is relaxed and inviting, every stroke carrying the same visual weight. Familjen Grotesk, with its lively, half-open bowls, sits beside it for brief stretches of text, so the page feels loose and friendly.
gen-gf-eagle-lake-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans is modern and monoline, a precise foil for the lightly tilted hand of Eagle Lake. Plus Jakarta Sans keeps its curve endings well apart, so extended text moves along without snagging.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-fs-epilogue: Graceful and relaxed, Euphoria Script keeps its capitals low, while Epilogue draws curvy, unclamped letters on a wire-like skeleton. Warm handwriting against steady wire, best used for just a few lines.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-fs-erode: Erode is dignified and editorial, beside Euphoria Script, which has no hairlines anywhere. Erode opens the g and a broadly and keeps ascenders shallow, so a brief sitting of text feels unhurried.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-fs-hind: Relaxed and graceful, Euphoria Script leans into handwriting, while Hind keeps lowercase close to capital height with strokes steady as drawn string. Hind carries a paragraph without fuss; the script prefers a brief line.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-general-sans: Smooth pressure runs from first letter to last, and the lowercase fills the line. General Sans follows the loose handwriting of Euphoria Script with steady sans-serif discipline, easy in modest amounts.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-manrope: Approachable and clean, Manrope leaves a bright gap at every curve. Euphoria Script, relaxed and graceful, is at its best set large over just a few words, where its close-fitting hand can breathe.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-switzer: Casual handwriting with a short step from lowercase tops to capital tops gives Euphoria Script its loose charm. And Switzer, tubular and wire-like with tips that never creep together, keeps that looseness tidy for brief lines.
